notes: Adds the missing saved-document review bridge required by the simple Source Documents workflow. Review & Verify can now reload the retained original and saved fields from the correct public/shared/private layers, preserve the destination couple metadata, edit saved passport fields without losing the protected original, and mark a complete document verified and archived. Existing protected records and passphrases remain local/private.
name: TEE v3.4.26 — Source Document Review Engine Fix
